latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Script 1

- Instantly generate 1080p video scripts from outlines or text inputs with AI-powered cloud rendering.
- Simple workflow: upload your outline or file, describe your target result, and download a ready-to-use MP4.
- Automatic setup with one-click anonymous authentication (no account required for trial credits).
- Easily check credits, session status, upload supported files, and export videos.
- Comprehensive error handling and status updates for a smooth user experience.
- Supports a wide range of input formats (mp4, mov, jpg, png, mp3, pdf, docx, etc.) up to 200MB in size.
